fields.statement: Verifier, attempt 3, at ff79bd5e5: go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/ciworkflow/... passes (TestCIChangesDecidesFromGitDiff, TestCIGoJobsRunOnlyOnCodeChanges, TestCIModelJobRunsOnlyOnModelChanges, TestCICheckAggregatesEveryJob plus the existing trigger, checkout/run-name, concurrency and jobs/matrices tests). Read .github/workflows/ci.yml: changes outputs code from git diff --name-only against git merge-base of the PR base and HEAD, code=true on non-pull_request events; lint, scripts, api, rest, budgets need changes with if code == 'true'; model needs changes with if code == 'false' and runs make self-check then go test -trimpath ./internal/op -run TestEveryFieldInRepoLogIsKnown (passes locally); check needs changes, model and the five Go jobs, if: always(), fails unless changes succeeded, fails on any result other than success/skipped, and fails when only changes succeeded. Makefile has no diff from the merge-base. The retry's commit 5cdf2698e amends ci-yml-parallel-jobs' statement and acceptance to match the new check job, closing the model finding. make self-check reports only stale-render fails for this run's own untracked actor records, refreshed at close-out. The clause about the next model-only PR's gh run view can only be read after merge.
